items.headline: Kamario Taylor leads 4th-quarter rally and No. 24 Mississippi State beats No. 19 Missouri 31-24
items.description: — Kamario Taylor threw for 360 yards and three touchdowns, including a tiebreaking, 24-yard pass to Sanfrisco Magee with 3:57 remaining, and No. 24 Mississippi State rallied past No. 19 Missouri 31-24 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Texas' UT jab at Tennessee leads top trolls of college football Week 4
items.description: Texas left Knoxville with a parting shot at its hosts centered on the two schools' shared UT acronym.

items.headline: Drinkwitz: Mizzou is channeling Kobe Bryant's attitude toward cowbells
items.description: Eliah Drinkwitz tells Marty & McGee the No. 19 Tigers won't "worry about cowbells blocking our jump shot" and details their plan to beat No. 24 MS State and QB Kamario Taylor.

items.headline: Davis praises No. 24 MS State's Taylor's poise in the spotlight
items.description: ESPN's Taylor Davis joins SEC Now to give a breakdown of how Kamario Taylor remains calm in chaos while Missouri is looking to bounce back from a off-week planning to drown out the cowbells.
